HOME.HERO_DESC: Hand-finished in Italy. Designed in Paris. Discover bags crafted to be carried — and treasured — for years.
HOME.BRAND_DESC: Every Bagcity bag is shaped by hand in our small Florentine atelier. We work only with vegetable-tanned leathers, solid brass hardware, and a single craftsperson per bag — because true luxury is in the details no one else sees.

ABOUT.TITLE: A small atelier with a quiet ambition
ABOUT.DESC: Bagcity was founded in 2026 in a quiet corner of the Marais. A decade later, we still make every bag the same way — by hand, in small numbers, with the same Italian leathers we began with.
ABOUT.CRAFT_P1: Each Bagcity bag is shaped by a single craftsperson from cut to final stitch. We work only with vegetable-tanned leathers from a family-run tannery outside Florence — leathers that begin honey-soft and only grow more beautiful with wear.
ABOUT.CRAFT_P2: Our hardware is solid brass, plated in real gold and finished by hand. The result is a bag that feels weighty in the palm — a quiet, lasting kind of luxury.
ABOUT.VALUE_1_DESC: Designed to be carried for a decade — not a season.
ABOUT.VALUE_2_DESC: Vegetable-tanned, traceable Italian leathers and recycled brass hardware.
ABOUT.VALUE_3_DESC: Every artisan in our atelier is paid a living wage and shares in our success.
ABOUT.CTA_DESC: Discover the bags our community returns to, season after season.

FAQ.TITLE: Frequently asked
FAQ.A1: Standard shipping arrives in 3–5 business days within the US and 5–10 days internationally. Complimentary shipping is included on all orders over $150.
FAQ.A2: We offer free 30-day returns on all unworn pieces in their original packaging. Simply email contact@bagcity.com to initiate a return.
FAQ.Q3: Are your bags made from real leather?
FAQ.A3: Yes — we use only full-grain, vegetable-tanned Italian leather from a family-run tannery outside Florence. We do not use synthetic substitutes.
FAQ.Q4: How should I care for my bag?
FAQ.A4: Store your bag in its dust cover when not in use. Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth. We include a complimentary leather conditioner with every order.
FAQ.A5: Every Bagcity bag is covered by our 2-year craftsmanship guarantee. If anything is not right, we will repair or replace it at no cost.
FAQ.A6: Yes — complimentary monogramming is available on most styles. Add your initials at checkout, or contact our concierge team for bespoke requests.
FAQ.Q7: What payment methods do you accept?
FAQ.A7: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Your information is encrypted at every step.
FAQ.A8: Yes, we ship to over 60 countries. Duties and taxes are calculated at checkout for full transparency.

SHIPPING.TITLE: Delivered with care
SHIPPING.DESC: Every order is packed by hand in our Paris studio and shipped with a tracking link. Free returns within 14 days, no questions asked.
SHIPPING.PERK_1_DESC: Complimentary standard shipping on all qualifying orders.
SHIPPING.PERK_2_DESC: Orders before 12pm CET ship the same business day.
SHIPPING.PERK_3_DESC: Change your mind? We'll cover the return shipping.
SHIPPING.PERK_4_DESC: Every bag carries our lifetime craftsmanship guarantee.
SHIPPING.OPT_2_NOTE: Order before 12pm CET for same-day dispatch
SHIPPING.OPT_3_NOTE: Available on weekdays for orders before 10am CET
SHIPPING.OPT_4_NOTE: Available to 40+ countries. Duties may apply.
SHIPPING.SQ1: When will my order be dispatched?
SHIPPING.SA1: Orders placed before 12pm CET Monday–Friday are dispatched the same day. Orders placed after 12pm or on weekends ship the next business day. You will receive a tracking link by email as soon as your order leaves our atelier.
SHIPPING.SA2: Yes — we ship to over 40 countries. International shipping rates and estimated delivery times are shown at checkout based on your destination. Please note that import duties and taxes may be charged by your country's customs authority and are the responsibility of the recipient.
SHIPPING.SQ3: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
SHIPPING.SA3: If your order has not yet been dispatched, contact us at contact@bagcity.com within one hour of placing your order and we will do our best to update the address. Once dispatched, we are unable to redirect shipments.
SHIPPING.SQ4: What if my order arrives damaged?
SHIPPING.SA4: Every Bagcity bag is inspected and wrapped by hand before dispatch. In the unlikely event that your order arrives damaged, please photograph the packaging and the bag and email us within 48 hours. We will arrange a replacement or full refund immediately.
SHIPPING.RETURNS_DESC: We want you to love your bag. If for any reason you don't, returning it is simple and free.
SHIPPING.RA1: We accept returns within 14 days of delivery for full-price items. Items must be unworn, undamaged, and returned in their original dust bag and box. Sale items are final sale and cannot be returned.
SHIPPING.RQ2: How do I start a return?
SHIPPING.RA2: Email contact@bagcity.com with your order number and the reason for your return. We will send you a prepaid return label within 24 hours. Once we receive and inspect the item, your refund will be processed within 3–5 business days to your original payment method.
SHIPPING.RA3: Yes. If you would like a different size, colour, or style, please note your preference when initiating your return and we will reserve the item for you. If the item is unavailable, we will issue a full refund.
SHIPPING.RA4: Returns within France are always complimentary. For international returns, we cover the first return on every order. Subsequent returns from the same order may incur a $12 return shipping fee.
SHIPPING.RQ5: When will I receive my refund?
SHIPPING.RA5: Refunds are processed within 3–5 business days of us receiving your returned item. Depending on your bank, it may take a further 5–10 business days to appear on your statement.
SHIPPING.QUESTIONS_DESC: Our client care team is available Monday to Saturday, 9am–7pm CET.

OUR_STORY.TITLE: A small atelier with a quiet ambition
OUR_STORY.DESC: Bagcity was founded in 2026 in a quiet corner of the Marais. A decade later, we still make every bag the same way — by hand, in small numbers, with the same Italian leathers we began with.
OUR_STORY.BEGIN_P1: Lior Ashkenazi spent fifteen years in the leather ateliers of Florence before returning to Paris with a single conviction: that the handbag industry had forgotten how to be patient. She opened our first studio on Rue des Archives with two craftspeople, a worn-out press, and a tannery relationship that would shape everything we make.
OUR_STORY.BEGIN_P2: Our first collection — six styles, made in an edition of forty — sold out in a week. We have kept the same approach ever since: small runs, unhurried craft, nothing made that we would not carry ourselves.
OUR_STORY.CRAFT_P1: Each Bagcity bag is shaped by a single craftsperson from cut to final stitch. We work only with vegetable-tanned leathers from a family-run tannery outside Florence — leathers that begin honey-soft and only grow more beautiful with wear.
OUR_STORY.CRAFT_P2: Our hardware is solid brass, plated in real gold and finished by hand. The result is a bag that feels weighty in the palm — a quiet, lasting kind of luxury.
OUR_STORY.VALUE_1_D: Designed to be carried for a decade — not a season. Each bag comes with a lifetime repair guarantee.
OUR_STORY.VALUE_2_D: Vegetable-tanned, traceable Italian leathers and recycled brass hardware. No chrome, no compromise.
OUR_STORY.VALUE_3_D: Every artisan in our atelier is paid a living wage and shares in our success.
OUR_STORY.TODAY_P1: We employ twelve people across our Paris studio and Florence atelier. We produce fewer than three thousand bags a year. We have declined every offer to scale, license our name, or open a second location.
OUR_STORY.TODAY_P2: Smallness is not a constraint — it is the point. It is what lets us know every bag by name, answer every question ourselves, and stand behind every stitch without reservation.
OUR_STORY.CTA_DESC: Discover the bags our community returns to, season after season.
